label: TanStack Start (React)
streaming: streamed (TanStack Start default stream handler; loader data dehydrated into the HTML)
notes: Nitro 3.0.260610-beta (the version the official scaffold pins) node-server preset.
Router defaults from the scaffold kept: defaultPreload 'intent', scrollRestoration.

The form is a plain <form action={fn.url} method=post multipart> (no-JS path) whose onSubmit calls the server function through useServerFn (thrown redirect → client navigation, returned {error} → state).
